title: Card wording consistency
notes: Same effect, same words: cards that run the same engine verb print the same clause (draw, random discard, steal, Make Radiant, adjacent, gains, Attack and Health, Recruit, Return to hand, (N) Cost, each enemy, Plague Counter placement, damage or heal), and core-073 Anti-oneshot Armor prints 'at a time' like classicplus-011 Anime Armor (#911). Shorter words for long faces: Fortify Mind's rules sentence, Jade Beauty without the Allure reminder its glossary line gives, Jungle Loser's Radiant face without its parenthesis, The Maestro's opponent and piles (#912). Cut to the face's text limit (#1017, R1017000): every face over six lines of 28 characters, which a 170 px face holds at the reading floor, reworded shorter (79 faces on 47 cards); Mind Games, Fortify Mind, YileGPT Unleashed, Yile's Virus and Reach the Summit put the lines their faces print first, and the client prints a short form or a clamp for the cards a list still keeps over it. Tesla's clarification, Jade Beauty's Allure reminder and Jlockeed's Evil Blueprints' 'Piece together the blueprint' return as a last line the face hides behind its '…' (R1017000). Wording only; mechanics, params and numbers unchanged, but for core-050 K-Pop Fanatic (#1045, R1045000), which ships under this claim: its Cry Allures the enemy permanent it chooses, as Jade Beauty Allures every enemy Unit, so its text is shorter, its target carries Allure's pink mark, and a target with no open zone in its row on the stealer's side is destroyed instead of staying with the opponent.

changes: K-Pop Fanatic Allures the enemy permanent it chooses: if you have no room for it when you steal it, it is destroyed.

Golly Bob Howdy, Polymorph and Mushroom Power say adjacent, as Hit Job and Collateral Damage do.
Death Boil, Normal Grape and Large Grape print one sentence: deal damage to an enemy or heal an ally.
Attack and Health are capitalised on every card, and Mid Loser and Bot Loser gain their stats as other Units do.
Gravedigger returns a card from your graveyard to hand, and Call to Arms recruits Units of (1) Cost or less, as Cookie Guild does.
Permanent Underclassman and Upperclassman summon a (1) and a (4) Cost Unit, and Upperclassman's Death says the fusion goes to your hand.
Rotten Grape says Lose 5 health, Jlockeed Shredder-10 hits each enemy, Fed Fauci places its Plague Counter and Claude's Datacenter adds an AI generated card.

title: Patch v0.3.17: no opponent decisions off their turn
notes: Issue #1279: no card asks a player to decide while they are not the active player (R1279000). The three cards that held a prompt for the opponent defer it to the start of the opponent's next turn with the engine's delay, and ask at once when the opponent is already active. Pickle (classic-008): its opponent answers its questions at the start of their next turn instead of during yours, and at once when it is cast on their turn, and its text says so. Income Tax (classic-009): when it reveals while its drawer is not active, the keep-one prompt waits for the start of their next turn with the Radiant discount it would have carried. Its text is unchanged: the sentence saying so would put both its faces over the face's text limit (R1017000). In Too Deep (classic-090): its reward G's discard, the opponent's own choice, waits for the start of their next turn while they are not active, and the quest G leads to opens once it resolves. Only Pickle's card data changed, so this fragment claims it alone; the other two changed only their scripts, and their player lines are here. All three keep the scripts v0.3.16 and every version before it ran, for their replays (KEPT_SCRIPTS, R767000).
